integrity: The proof independently derives annihilator classes from chain-ring valuations, proves a unique-neighbor forcing lemma for one witness per local factor, and derives all total and paired minima from that forced core. Direct multiplication-table checks on small product rings corroborate the valuation model.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite commutative principal ideal rings.
A local ring of nilpotency length two gives an isolated compressed vertex, so total and paired domination do not exist there.
Ordinary domination of these compressed graphs has prior coverage and is not asserted as new.
The full text of the 2020 ordinary-domination paper on compressed zero-divisor graphs was not available through the inspected lawful open routes; only its accessible abstract was compared.
The finite verifier is corroborative and does not replace the symbolic proof.
title: Forced total-domination cores in compressed zero-divisor graphs of finite principal ideal rings
